linux-fileless-execution.title: Linux fileless or anonymous-file execution
linux-fileless-execution.hypothesis: A Linux process executes from a memfd or /proc file-descriptor path, or stages an executable in a transient directory, consistent with fileless payload or miner execution.
telemetry: Linux process creation with executable paths and command lines
Audit or EDR telemetry for memfd_create and execve where available
Network and persistence activity from the resulting process
investigate: Capture the process memory or recovered executable, parent tree, user, container, and destination.
Correlate the execution with downloads, persistence changes, mining traffic, or reverse shells.
linux-fileless-execution.limitation: Updaters, runtimes, and security tools can legitimately execute anonymous files. Process collectors differ in how they represent memfd paths, so absence of a match is not proof of absence.
linux-fileless-execution.visibility: Linux process and audit telemetry where collected
linux-fileless-execution.query_scope: Linux process candidates whose image or command line exposes a memfd or procfs descriptor. Tune known runtimes and require supporting behavior before alerting.

queries.sigma:
title: Hunt - Linux Anonymous File Execution
id: afc1e20b-3eae-46fd-b736-e14b639f3a66
status: experimental
description: Detects process paths or command lines associated with memfd and procfs file-descriptor execution.
author: MagicSword OpenAttacks catalog
date: 2026-11-06
references:
  - https://github.com/elastic/detection-rules/blob/main/rules/linux/defense_evasion_fileless_execution_via_unusual_memfd_create.toml
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate runtimes, updaters, and security software using anonymous files
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|contains:
      - /memfd:
      - /proc/self/fd/
      - /proc/thread-self/fd/
  selection_command:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - memfd:
      - /proc/self/fd/
      - /proc/thread-self/fd/
  condition: 1 of selection_*
queries.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where OSPlatform =~ "Linux"
| where FolderPath has_any ("/memfd:", "/proc/self/fd/", "/proc/thread-self/fd/")
    or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("memfd:", "/proc/self/fd/", "/proc/thread-self/fd/")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
    InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA1
| order by Timestamp desc
queries.spl:
| tstats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime
  from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
  where Processes.process IN ("*memfd:*", "*/proc/self/fd/*", "*/proc/thread-self/fd/*")
  by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process
     Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| sort - lastTime
